project_name: LelangOto Premium - Car & Vehicle Auction MVP Blueprint
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO x LUXURY EDITORIAL (Premium Automotive Auction)
emotional_tone: Exclusive, High-Octane, Precision, Prestigious, Editorial Authority

theme_strategy.design_rationale: Automotive luxury & live bidding high-tension environments thrive on deep navy/obsidian canvases accented by vibrant kinetic orange (#FF5E1F) and warm porcelain surfaces for crisp specs legibility.

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono / Space Mono (For Live Bid Timers, Currency, & Lot IDs)

scale_hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase leading-none
scale_hierarchy.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg text-slate-400 font-normal leading-relaxed
scale_hierarchy.ticker_numeric: font-mono font-bold text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-wider text-amber-500
scale_hierarchy.lot_badge: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-slate-400

contrast_rules.bid_button: bg-[#FF5E1F] hover:bg-[#E0480C] text-white font-bold shadow-lg shadow-orange-950/40

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/10 before:absolute before:inset-0 before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-transparent before:via-[#FF5E1F]/20 before:to-transparent before:-translate-x-full hover:before:animate-[shimmer_2s_infinite]

layout_and_bento_grids.hero_layout: Asymmetric editorial split: Left (60%) featuring high-octane featured lot with real-time live ticker countdown, Right (40%) showcasing live auction feed stream & quick place-bid widget.
layout_and_bento_grids.lot_detail_layout: Top section: High-resolution gallery with thumbnail slider & sticky auction action bar; Bottom split: Left 65% (Technical specs sheet, condition inspection report PDF preview, vehicle history log), Right 35% (Bidder room widget, automated increment calculator, bid activity history table, watchlist button).

key_features_and_flows.1_catalog_and_filtering: Search by make/model, filter by Lot Category (Supercar, Classic/Vintage, Luxury SUV, Muscle Car, EV/Hypercar), status (Live Now, Upcoming, Ended), price range, and location in Indonesia (Jakarta, Surabaya, Bali, Bandung).
key_features_and_flows.2_lot_detail_view: Rich gallery with zoom, inspection score badge (e.g. 98/100 Grade A), comprehensive specs (Engine, Mileage, Transmission, VIN, BPKB/STNK status), seller verified badge.
key_features_and_flows.3_live_bidding_simulation: Real-time interactive bidding simulator! Instant bid increments (+Rp 5.000.000, +Rp 10.000.000, +Rp 25.000.000 or custom input). Auto-updating highest bidder badge, persistent bid log saved in local database/state, sound/toast alerts on outbid.
key_features_and_flows.4_countdown_timer: Dynamic precision clock (Hours, Minutes, Seconds) with amber accent state when < 15 mins remaining.
key_features_and_flows.5_user_dashboard_and_bids_history: Tabbed view for 'Bids Saya' (Active Bids, Winning Lots, Outbid Alerts), 'Watchlist', and 'Simulasi Saldo Deposit/Bidding Limit'.
key_features_and_flows.6_auth_modal: Simple, seamless bidder persona switch (e.g., 'Budi Santoso - Verified Bidder VIP' vs 'Siti Rahma - Collector Grade'). No real payment required as requested.

featured_supercars.title: 1964 Chevrolet Impala SS Convertible Black Edition

presets.modal_backdrop: initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All actionable buttons, inputs, filter dropdowns, bid action buttons, countdown timers, and bid history items MUST feature explicit data-testid attributes (kebab-case).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this entire design_guidelines.json before building any component.
2. Implement the dark premium automotive theme (#0B132B midnight navy background, #FF5E1F kinetic orange CTA buttons, JetBrains Mono font for numbers and timers).

3. Build key components: Navbar with user bidder selector, Hero Section with live timer & main lot, Catalog Grid with Filters & Sorts, Vehicle Detail Modal/Page with inspection specs & bid simulator, Bid History Drawer/Tab, and Toast Notifications via Sonner.
4. Store bid history in state/localStorage or API so bidder user actions persist during session testing.
5. Ensure all interactive elements include proper data-testid attributes.
6. Do NOT call third-party payment gateways; use instant simulated bid response with celebratory sound effect / animated toast feedback.
